Most volume fields read -6.0 dB with a red automation dot. 1B-Audio reads 0 dB, 1n2-Aud-In -12.0 dB, and utility and SONOBUS BRIDGE 0 dB. Pans on 1A-Audio through 2B-Audio also carry automation dots.
The four layers record the Microfreak from external input 3. 1A-Audio, 2A-Audio and 2B-Audio send their audio to the 1n2 track; 1B-Audio goes straight to Main.

1n2 sums its three layers and is assigned to the crossfader's A side. 2B-Audio passes through its own B assignment and then 1n2's A assignment, so the room hears it only with the crossfader near the middle. Only 1B-Audio reaches Main from the B side alone. Ableton/Live/UG/18 Mixing/05 Using Live's Crossfader
3A-Audio, 3B-Audio, 4A-Audio and 4B-Audio take the outputs of 1A-Audio, 1B-Audio, 2A-Audio and 2B-Audio and feed 3n4, which also resamples Main. They hold only "silence" clips in this Set.
1n2-Aud-In and 1n2-Aud-Out send input 3 and 1n2 to external outputs 3/4. B-Aud-In and B-Aud-Out send input 3 and 3n4 to external output 4.

LPP to MF carries the Launchpad Pro's channel 1 to the MicroFreak, and MF to LPP carries the MicroFreak back to the Launchpad's sequencer. 1n2-MIDI also sends to the MicroFreak, and B2-MIDI listens to 1n2-MIDI.

In this Knowledge Garden, Launchpad means the Novation Launchpad Pro Mk3. Other Launchpad models belong under the Novation/Launchpad namespace.
User guide for the Launchpad, the Novation Launchpad Pro Mk3 grid controller.
Launchpad Pro is a grid controller for producing and performing with Ableton Live or external MIDI hardware.
Its 64 velocity- and pressure-sensitive RGB pads can launch clips, play notes, and sequence steps. The four-track, 32-step sequencer provides probability and mutation controls for evolving patterns.
Eight Custom Modes can send MIDI to software or hardware. The two MIDI output ports extend control to external instruments.
The unit can operate without a computer when powered through its USB-C port by the included wall adapter.
Ableton Live integration: play, record, and produce from the controller.
Pads: 64 RGB pads sense velocity and pressure.
Sequencer: four tracks with 32-step patterns, scenes, probability, and mutation.
Chord Mode: explore, build, save, and play chords from the grid.
Note and Scale Modes: play melodies and chords in key; Drum Mode maps a drum rack to the grid.
MIDI connections: MIDI In, Out 1, and Out 2/Thru connect external equipment.
Custom Modes: eight editable MIDI layouts made with Novation Components.
